publication_binding.read_rule: Resolve the current payload commit from main authority first; then verify this manifest and receipt from that immutable payload.

reader_contract.selection: Read this manifest first, then read the requested symbol chunk(s).
reader_contract.completeness: The union of weekly chunks equals stock_weekly_ohlcv.csv exactly by symbol and rows; the union of daily chunks equals daily_bridge.csv.
reader_contract.integrity: Every chunk bytes/sha256/rows must match this manifest before Method-Locked use.
reader_contract.lineage: All chunks are generated from the current materialized payload and publisher_generation_id; payload commit is resolved by external authority after publication.
reader_contract.intraday: Intraday remains a separate status-only overlay and never replaces completed EOD or weekly rows.
reader_contract.failure: If any requested chunk is missing, empty, or hash-mismatched, return PUBLIC_HISTORY_CHUNKS_UNAVAILABLE.
